output.reason: The changelog line [ev-edfb2e66c4df] and the PR description [ev-42c5e8da4c8d][ev-d1b914d4df03] say what the feature does. It adds per-tenant configuration of which OTLP resource attributes become stream labels, which were previously hardcoded, and it adds a relabel-style way to drop unwanted data. The changed files [ev-6971c94ee350] show it lives in the per-tenant limits (pkg/validation/limits.go, otlp_config.go). None of the evidence gives the config key or its default, and none says whether the default mapping keeps the old hardcoded behaviour. The PR also defers documentation to a separate PR [ev-d1b914d4df03]. Without the key, the default, and whether OTLP-ingesting environments see any change when left alone, the applicability condition can't be written.
